data.opportunityTitle: NIOSH Support for Conferences and Scientific Meetings (U13 Clinical Trial Not Allowed)

agencyDetails.agencyName: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention - ERA

topAgencyDetails.agencyName: Department of Health and Human Services

forecast.forecastDesc: The purpose of the NIOSH Support for Conferences and Scientific Meetings (U13) program is to support high-quality scientific meetings, conferences, and workshops that are relevant to the NIOSH mission and that promote occupational safety and health. The conference program is an important part of the NIOSH mission. Applications should address and advance research topics in occupational safety and health that align with NIOSH program priorities. A conference or scientific meeting is a gathering, symposium, seminar, workshop, or other organized meeting in which participants meet in person or virtually to coordinate, exchange, and share information or to explore and clarify a specific topic, problem, or area of knowledge. This cooperative agreement is used when substantial federal scientific or programmatic involvement is expected, and federal staff may assist, guide, coordinate, or participate in project activities before and after the award. Applications for training-only events will not be considered under this announcement.
forecast.agencyContactName: Sharon Chiou, PhD, Scientific Program Official
forecast.applicantEligibilityDesc: Non-domestic (non-U.S.) Entities (Foreign Institutions) are not eligible to apply. Non-domestic (non-U.S.) components of U.S. Organizations are not eligible to apply. Foreign components, as defined in the HHS Grants Policy Statement, are not allowed.
forecast.estApplicationResponseDateDesc: April 12, 2027, for New applications;Standard due dates apply for future due dates.All applications must be submitted no later than 11:59 pm local time of the applicant organization.
